result.quote: may fire come from Abimelech and consume the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo
result.reason: The curse is reciprocal: fire from Abimelech is to consume the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo, and fire from those leaders is to consume Abimelech. The key broadly captures Shechem and Abimelech but materially omits Beth-millo and the reciprocal source of the fire.
